method.host: Intel i5-7260U, 2 cores / 4 threads, Linux CPU
method.sse: local deterministic fixture, one word every 70 ms
method.metric: first PCM, not physical speaker onset
method.voiceClock: STT transcribe request -> first reply PCM; excludes microphone/VAD silence and external-provider latency
method.baseline: HEAD renderer/chunker policy, current shared diagnostic instrumentation
limits: Narrow synthetic English speech and long punctuation-free opening; not general human/noise accuracy or live cloud latency.
STT and synthesis timings vary with host load; whole-pipeline delta is not entirely attributable to the chunker.
